reasoning: The 2023 baseline failure rate was 22.9%. The new GB 1499.2-2024 standard took effect September 2024 with stricter requirements (tighter tolerances). Key factors: 1) Stricter standards typically increase failure rates initially as producers adjust, 2) However, mandatory enforcement (vs recommendatory) creates strong compliance incentives, 3) Chinese regulatory crackdowns often show rapid industry response, 4) The construction sector downturn may reduce pressure to cut corners. Given ~6 months since implementation by end of 2025, some improvement is likely but achieving <20% (down from 22.9%) with stricter standards is uncertain. I estimate moderate probability.
